title: This free AI tool lets you clone any website with just one single screenshot.
description:
This free AI tool lets you clone any website with just one single screenshot.

It's called Screenshot to Code.

It's a fully open source project with over 72,000 stars on GitHub.

You just drop in a screenshot.

It reads the layout, the spacing, the fonts, and the colors.

Then it builds the entire website for you.

And it works on more than just screenshots.

You can give it a Figma design, reference images, or even a screen recording of a website.

It turns that into a fully working prototype in minutes.

Plus you also get a live canvas.

You can tweak anything however you want directly inside it.

No more starting from a blank file every time you find a design you like.

You just capture it, feed it in, and let the tool rebuild it for you.

#githubrepo #aiwebsites #aidesigning #websitecloner #screenshottocode
